author: Haruko
name: BattleMetric
short: BattleMetrics API, HLL RCON, account-link, and stats cog.
description: Modular Redbot cog for BattleMetrics server data, Server Info panels, HLL: Vietnam kill feeds, PostgreSQL statistics, and verified Discord-to-EOS account linking.
install_msg: BattleMetric loaded. Use [p]help battlemetric, [p]help serverinfo, [p]help killfeed, or /link to see commands.
end_user_data_statement: Reads global BattleMetrics, HLL RCON, and PostgreSQL secrets from Red's shared API-token storage; stores per-guild settings and authorized Discord user IDs; and stores verified Discord-to-EOS account links and aggregated HLL kill/death statistics in the configured PostgreSQL database.
